The main takeaway from our work is that
the brain patterns associated with the construction of an event are very similar to those found during the original encoding and recollection of the same event.
the brain of an individual who is mentally constructing an episode based on a communication with another person is very much the same as that of the person who actually experienced the episode.
neural patterns associated with encoding a real-life episode are shared across the brain of the original experiencer, the memory recaller and the memory constructor.
